title: Inspect the shipped identity and navigation components
description: A developer uses the production gallery's actual shared components. Explicit local specimens expose keyboard focus, selected, disabled, pending, invalid and recovery states. Local activation counts are component callbacks, not service receipts or authentication acceptance. The reference page deliberately scrolls; these captures do not certify remaining gameplay specimens.
